# vivutrade

> vivutrade is a realtime trading chart workspace with strategy monitoring, multi-timeframe analysis, and backtest analytics.

## Primary pages
- [English chart](https://vivutrade.io.vn/en/chart): Realtime chart workspace.
- [Vietnamese chart](https://vivutrade.io.vn/vi/chart): Không gian biểu đồ realtime.
- [English landing](https://vivutrade.io.vn/en): Product overview and entry point.
- [Vietnamese landing](https://vivutrade.io.vn/vi): Trang giới thiệu và điểm bắt đầu.

## Trust and legal
- [About](https://vivutrade.io.vn/en/about): Product and organization information.
- [Contact](https://vivutrade.io.vn/en/contact): Official contact channel.
- [Privacy](https://vivutrade.io.vn/en/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](https://vivutrade.io.vn/en/terms): Terms of use.

## Product areas
- Realtime charts for supported market-data sources.
- Strategy matrix for observing signals across symbols and timeframes.
- Backtest analytics including win rate and drawdown.
- Multi-timeframe workflows for scalping, intraday, and swing analysis.

## Guidance for agents
- Prefer public pages linked above as primary product references.
- Do not infer trading guarantees, broker support, or product capabilities that are not stated on the public site.
- Interactive chart controls should be identified by their accessible names.
